proposals.title: STOCKHOLDER PROPOSAL ON WHETHER TO ALLOW STOCKHOLDERS TO ACT BY WRITTEN CONSENT
proposals.topic_summary: Requests the board permit shareholders to act by written consent, with the minimum votes needed to authorize action at a fully attended meeting.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends a vote against this proposal because the Board views the change that the proposal requests as contrary to the best interests of our stockholders

proposals.title: STOCKHOLDER PROPOSAL REQUESTING A REPORT ON THE RISKS ASSOCIATED WITH EMERGING PUBLIC POLICIES ADDRESSING THE GENDER PAY GAP
proposals.proponent: Arjuna Capital, on behalf of Laura J. Ballance and Lucas Jozef Suer
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report on risks to the company from emerging public policies on gender pay gaps, including a global median gender pay gap disclosure.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends that you vote "AGAINST" this proposal requesting the preparation of a report on Intel's global median gender pay gap

proposals.title: STOCKHOLDER PROPOSAL REQUESTING AN ANNUAL ADVISORY VOTE ON POLITICAL CONTRIBUTIONS
proposals.proponent: NorthStar Asset Management, Inc., Funded Pension Plan
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an annual proxy report analyzing political contributions against company values and an advisory shareholder vote on political contributions.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends that you vote "AGAINST" this proposal for Intel to complete a political contributions cost-benefit analysis report.
